title: Electric Motor, Power Tool, and Related Repairers
description: Repair, maintain, or install electric motors, wiring, or switches.

projection.title: Electric motor, power tool, and related repairers

tasks.text: Inspect and test equipment to locate damage or worn parts and diagnose malfunctions, or read work orders or schematic drawings to determine required repairs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Diagnosis from description aided, repair judgment human

dwas.name: Read work orders or descriptions of problems to determine repairs or modifications needed.
Inspect mechanical equipment to locate damage, defects, or wear.

tasks.text: Reassemble repaired electric motors to specified requirements and ratings, using hand tools and electrical meters.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Reassembly after repair requires hands-on fitting

dwas.name: Reassemble equipment after repair.

tasks.text: Measure velocity, horsepower, revolutions per minute (rpm), amperage, circuitry, and voltage of units or parts to diagnose problems, using ammeters, voltmeters, wattmeters, and other testing devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Requires physical gauges and instrument reading

dwas.name: Measure equipment outputs.

tasks.text: Repair and rebuild defective mechanical parts in electric motors, generators, and related equipment, using hand tools and power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on engine teardown and repair

dwas.name: Repair defective engines or engine components.
Rebuild parts or components.

tasks.text: Lift units or parts such as motors or generators, using cranes or chain hoists, or signal crane operators to lift heavy parts or subassemblies.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Install/repair coordination is situated teamwork

dwas.name: Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.
Communicate with coworkers to coordinate installations or repairs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Record repairs required, parts used, and labor time.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Log maintenance and repair records from data

dwas.name: Maintain repair or maintenance records.

tasks.text: Disassemble defective equipment so that repairs can be made, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Disassembly requires hands-on tool use

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.

tasks.text: Adjust working parts, such as fan belts, contacts, and springs, using hand tools and gauges.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Lubricate moving parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lubrication task requiring hands and access

dwas.name: Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning.

tasks.text: Read service guides to find information needed to perform repairs.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Technical reading for maintenance well handled

dwas.name: Read technical information needed to perform maintenance or repairs.

tasks.text: Inspect electrical connections, wiring, relays, charging resistance boxes, and storage batteries, following wiring diagrams.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Defect detection in electrical systems needs presence

dwas.name: Inspect electrical or electronic systems for defects.

tasks.text: Scrape and clean units or parts, using cleaning solvents and equipment such as buffing wheels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning parts for repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.

tasks.text: Weld, braze, or solder electrical connections.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on brazing of metal parts in unstructured shop

dwas.name: Braze metal parts or components.

tasks.text: Verify and adjust alignments and dimensions of parts, using gauges and tracing lathes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Steam-clean polishing and buffing wheels to remove abrasives and bonding materials, and spray, brush, or recoat surfaces as necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning parts for repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.

tasks.text: Set machinery for proper performance, using computers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Test equipment for overheating, using speed gauges and thermometers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Reface, ream, and polish commutators and machine parts to specified tolerances, using machine tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hand sanding and finishing of physical objects

dwas.name: Smooth surfaces of objects or equipment.

tasks.text: Maintain stocks of parts.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Materials inventory records and forecasting automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.

tasks.text: Cut and form insulation, and insert insulation into armature, rotor, or stator slots.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cutting to specifications

dwas.name: Install insulation in equipment or structures.
Cut materials according to specifications or needs.

tasks.text: Assemble electrical parts such as alternators, generators, starting devices, and switches, following schematic drawings and using hand, machine, and power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical subsystem assembly requires manual dexterity

dwas.name: Assemble electrical components, subsystems, or systems.

tasks.text: Solder, wrap, and coat wires to ensure proper insulation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Soldering connections needs precise manual work

dwas.name: Solder parts or connections between parts.

tasks.text: Rewire electrical systems, and repair or replace electrical accessories.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical component-level repair work

dwas.name: Rewire electrical or electronic systems.
Repair electrical components.

tasks.text: Clean cells, cell assemblies, glassware, leads, electrical connections, and battery poles, using scrapers, steam, water, emery cloths, power grinders, or acid.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning parts for repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.

tasks.text: Rewind coils on cores in slots, or make replacement coils, using coil-winding machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling

dwas.name: Fabricate parts or components.

tasks.text: Remove and replace defective parts such as coil leads, carbon brushes, and wires, using soldering equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual replacement of mechanical parts

dwas.name: Remove parts or components from equipment.
Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Hammer out dents and twists in tools and equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual dent removal with tools on varied surfaces

dwas.name: Remove dents from equipment, materials, tools or structures.

tasks.text: Seal joints with putty, mortar, and asbestos, using putty extruders and knives.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sealing gaps requires hands-on application

dwas.name: Seal gaps or cracks to prevent leakage or moisture intrusion.

tasks.text: Repair and operate battery-charging equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on electronic equipment repair

dwas.name: Repair electronic equipment.

tasks.text: Sharpen tools such as saws, picks, shovels, screwdrivers, and scoops, either manually or by using bench grinders and emery wheels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual sharpening of cutting tools

dwas.name: Sharpen cutting or grinding tools.

tasks.text: Test battery charges, and replace or recharge batteries as necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical probing and meter work by hand

dwas.name: Test electrical circuits or components for proper functioning.
Repair electronic equipment.
